arxiv-1404-6247.title: Career on the Move: Geography, Stratification, and Scientific Impact
arxiv-1404-6247.creator: Pierre Deville, Dashun Wang, Roberta Sinatra, Chaoming Song, Vincent D. Blondel, Albert-László Barabási ∗,
arxiv-1404-6247.description: Abstract Changing institutions is an integral part of an academic life. Yet little is known about the mobility patterns of scientists at an institutional level and how these career choices affect scientific outcomes. Here, we examine over 420,000 papers, to track the affiliation information of individual scientists, allowing us to reconstruct their career trajectories over decades.

arxiv-2109-07924.title: Small Promise CSPs that reduce to large CSPs
arxiv-2109-07924.creator: Alexandr Kazda ORCID:0000-0002-7338-037X, Peter Mayr ORCID:0000-0003-1163-313X, Dmitriy Zhuk ORCID:0000-0003-0047-5076
arxiv-2109-07924.description: Abstract . For relational structures 𝐀 , 𝐁 \mathbf{A},\mathbf{B} of the same signature, the Promise Constraint Satisfaction Problem PCSP ⁡ ( 𝐀 , 𝐁 ) \mathrm{PCSP}(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B}) asks whether a given input structure maps homomorphically to 𝐀 \mathbf{A} or does not even map to 𝐁 \mathbf{B} . We are promised that the input satisfies exactly one of these two cases.

arxiv-2308-15937.title: Quantum Plasmons in Double Layer Systems
arxiv-2308-15937.creator: Luis Brey 1 and H.A.Fertig 1,2,3
arxiv-2308-15937.description: Abstract Plasmons are fundamental excitations of metals which can be described in terms of electron dynamics, or in terms of the electromagnetic fields associated with them. In this work we develop a quantum description of plasmons in a double layer structure, treating them as confined electromagnetic modes of the structure.

arxiv-2402-18364.title: Extracting the Luttinger parameter from a single wave function
arxiv-2402-18364.creator: Bi-Yang Tan 1, Yueshui Zhang 2, Hua-Chen Zhang 3 , Wei Tang 4 , Lei Wang 5,6, Hong-Hao Tu 2, Ying-Hai Wu 1
arxiv-2402-18364.description: Abstract The low-energy physics of Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids (TLLs) is controlled by the Luttinger parameter. We demonstrate that this parameter can be extracted from a single wave function for one-component TLLs with periodic boundary condition. This method relies on the fact that TLLs are described by conformal field theory in which crosscap states can be constructed.

arxiv-2408-02026.title: Examination of ventilated cavities in the wake of a two-dimensional bluff body
arxiv-2408-02026.creator: Udhav U. Gawandalkar 1, Nicholas A. Lucido 2, Prachet Jain 2, Christian Poelma 1, Steven L. Ceccio 2,3, Harish Ganesh 2
arxiv-2408-02026.description: Abstract Ventilated cavities in the wake of a two-dimensional bluff body are studied experimentally via time-resolved X-ray densitometry. With a systematic variation of flow velocity and gas injection rate, expressed as Froude number ( F ​ r Fr ) and ventilation coefficient ( C q ​ s C_{qs} ), four stable cavities with different closures are identified.

arxiv-2412-02845.title: Optimized IoT Intrusion Detection using Machine Learning Technique
arxiv-2412-02845.creator: Muhammad Zawad Mahmud, Samiha Islam, Shahran Rahman Alve, Al Jubayer Pial
arxiv-2412-02845.description: Abstract An application of software known as an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) employs machine algorithms to identify network intrusions. Selective logging, safeguarding privacy, reputation-based defense against numerous attacks, and dynamic response to threats are a few of the problems that intrusion identification is used to solve.

arxiv-2504-19070.title: Sample-Efficient Language Model for Hinglish Conversational AI
arxiv-2504-19070.creator: Sakshi Singh Abhinav Prakash Aakriti Shah sakshisi@usc.edu ap42546@usc.edu shahaakr@usc.edu Chaitanya Sachdeva Sanjana Dumpala csachdev@usc.edu dumpala@usc.edu
arxiv-2504-19070.description: Abstract This paper presents our process for developing a sample-efficient language model for a conversational Hinglish chatbot. Hinglish, a code-mixed language that combines Hindi and English, presents a unique computational challenge due to inconsistent spelling, lack of standardization, and limited quality of conversational data. This work evaluates multiple pre-trained cross-lingual language models, including Gemma3-4B and Qwen2.

arxiv-2507-05300.title: Structured Captions Improve Prompt Adherence in Text-to-Image Models (Re-LAION-Caption 19M)
arxiv-2507-05300.creator: Nicholas Merchant, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Andrei Cristian Popescu, Carlos Garcia Jurado Suarez
arxiv-2507-05300.description: Abstract We argue that generative text-to-image models often struggle with prompt adherence due to the noisy and unstructured nature of large-scale datasets like LAION-5B. This forces users to rely heavily on prompt engineering to elicit desirable outputs. In this work, we propose that enforcing a consistent caption structure during training can significantly improve model controllability and alignment.

pmc-10596749.title: Environmental sustainability and healthiness of nursing homes meals: an exploratory study from Italy
pmc-10596749.creator: A Conti, J G Binala, L Cortese, A Opizzi, D Gigante, F Barone-Adesi, M Panella
pmc-10596749.description: BackgroundThe food sector is responsible for more than the 30% of the total greenhouse gases emissions (GHGE), one of the leading causes of global warming. The adoption of healthy and sustainable food models has been identified as one of the possible effective interventions to face this challenge.

pmc-12411392.title: Lithocholic acid ameliorates ulcerative colitis via the PXR/TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 signaling pathway and gut microbiota modulation
pmc-12411392.creator: Yaoyao Liu, Jie Gao, Lu Chen, Yanfang Chen, Jingjing Jiang, Hong Chen, Li Ma
pmc-12411392.description: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory condition of the colon, closely linked to dysbiosis of gut microbiota and imbalances in bile acids. Lithocholic acid (LCA), a secondary bile acid, plays a crucial role in maintaining gut health; however, its specific therapeutic potential in UC remains to be fully elucidated.

pmc-12644785.title: Reply to “Investigating a role for NSAIDs in the pathophysiology of vaccine-associated myocarditis”
pmc-12644785.creator: Alessandra Buoninfante, Marco Cavaleri
pmc-12644785.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hoption Cann proposes that nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID)s could play an important role in the pathophysiology of vaccine-associated myocarditis and could also have a synergistic effect with COVID-19 vaccines, because NSAIDs are administered often as antipyretic medications.

pmc-13166015.title: Hydraulic Seal Wear Classification by Fine-Tuning a Transformer-Based Audio Model Using Acoustic Emission
pmc-13166015.creator: Lisa Maria Svendsen, Vignesh V. Shanbhag, Rune Schlanbusch
pmc-13166015.description: Accurate classification of seal wear is essential for condition-based and predictive maintenance of hydraulic cylinders, where seal degradation can cause fluid leakage and impair normal system operation. This study investigates the adaptation of a Transformer-based audio model for classifying seal wear conditions using acoustic emission (AE) signals.

pmc-13272451.title: Clinical practice guidelines and quality standards for early intervention in psychosis: an AGREE II appraisal and systematic review of service components
pmc-13272451.creator: Pasquale Scognamiglio, Vassilis Martiadis, Giuseppe Diaspro, Luca Viacava, Anna Longobardi, Raffaele Rea, Valeria Iniziato, Pasquale Saviano, Silvestro La Pia
pmc-13272451.description: BackgroundEarly intervention in psychosis (EIP) is a key component of youth mental health care, yet recommended models of care for individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis (CHR-P) and first-episode psychosis (FEP) remain heterogeneous across jurisdictions. No previous study has combined a formal AGREE II appraisal with a structured synthesis of core service components for EIP.

pmc-13331325.title: Orbital Myeloid Sarcoma Masquerading as Orbital Cellulitis: A Diagnostic Challenge in an Adult Patient
pmc-13331325.creator: Rahisha Maskey, Sharan Thapa, Oliver W Spencer, Zoe Avila
pmc-13331325.description: Myeloid sarcoma (MS), also known as granulocytic sarcoma or chloroma, is a rare extramedullary manifestation of acute myeloid leukaemia (AML). It represents a tumour-like accumulation of myeloid blasts outside the bone marrow. Orbital involvement is uncommon and may mimic inflammatory or infectious conditions, creating significant diagnostic challenges.

uslaw-usc-t42-s16413.title: 42 U.S.C. § 16413 — National Center for Energy Management and Building Technologies
uslaw-usc-t42-s16413.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s16413.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 149 (National Energy Policy And Programs); Subchapter XI (Personnel And Training). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall support the ongoing activities of and explore opportunities for expansion of the National Center for Energy Management and Building Technologies to carry out research, education, and training activities to facilitate the improvement.
